entries.summary: Tablet/mobile Design overrides in layout_json (settings_tablet, design_mobile, …). Editor preview uses [data-device] CSS; public site uses @media max-width 1023.98px / 767.98px.
No schema change. Device overrides are keys inside layout_json; compiled CSS is still derived at render.
cms-builder-drag-column-size sets a tablet min-height of 160px and asserts it in #cmsBuilderLiveCss and public style.cms-layout-css media query.
